reviewNotes.status: Synthetic R09 proposal; exact screenshots are not yet approved
reviewNotes.identity: Existing R08/R07 desktop rail, header, Inter font and restrained palette. No mobile redesign.
reviewNotes.versions: Each Saved version represents one actual immutable coherent Shared/Application pair, backed by an exact native release ID. Human titles use the immutable saved reason/note and date; fallback Saved <timestamp>. Native actor references stay collapsed because readable human author names are not supplied. No inferred ordinal, version counter, new storage or migration.
reviewNotes.json: The displayed JSON is explicitly the Application layer of the selected saved pair, never a fabricated merged document. The exact Shared base is retained when copying an older version; it is not silently advanced to the latest Shared publication.
reviewNotes.saving: Save version authorizes existing publication then coherent-release originals sequentially with distinct keys. A partial save stays incomplete on this page and never appears as a deployable saved version. Saving does not change the deployed desired version.
reviewNotes.deployment: Deploy selects any actually saved version, including an older one, for the exact application/environment/configuration. The reviewed whole-map operation sets that release as default and clears all cohort pins. Existing targeting must be disclosed before confirmation. Metadata-only deployment can remain authorized while JSON is protected.
reviewNotes.deployed: Deployed names the exact current default desired assignment only when targeting is uniform. If cohort targeting differs, show that separately rather than claiming all instances have one deployed version. Consumer adoption is reported independently and is never immediate runtime proof.
reviewNotes.lifetime: Local unsaved text is distinct from immutable saved JSON. Dirty leave/cancel, current session/tuple/grants/preconditions, original-result retention and partial/unknown outcomes remain mandatory. Technical references stay collapsed; URL slugs are decorative while exact selectors retain authority boundaries.
reviewNotes.resize: The 900px preview stacks the same finite version list and JSON panel within the available desktop canvas. This is a proposed layout, not a passing browser geometry test.
